PRE-FAILOVER CHECKLIST:
[ ] Confirm genuine regional outage, not a blip
[ ] Confirm replication lag was under 60s at last reading
[ ] *** Verify every connected app resolves through
    thornridge-sql-failover-group.database.windows.net --
    NOT the primary server's own name, directly. ***
[ ] Notify on-call lead, open incident ticket
